item.tib: ngo sprod rin po che yis gsol 'debs rgyab bskyor gyi gdam pa
item.coloph: de ltar ngo sprod rin po che gsal 'debs gyi (kyi) gdams pa/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyi dgongs tshul dang/ mnyam med 'dul ba rin po che'i zhal gdams phyag len dang mi 'gal bar/ dus snyigs ma'i bru bsgoms (sgom) rgyal ba g.yung drung la/ phyogs med kyi nyams su len pa 'dru bsgoms ('gru sgom)sbyin pa 'od zer gyis bskul te/ gab pa bton sbas pa bshigs bskyangs (bskungs) pa phyung ste tshigs (tshig) don gsal bar spros nas/ rin chen spungs pa mkhar sna'i dgon par sbyar/ 'gal 'khrul bshags zhing (shing) dge ba dbyings su bsngo/ dpag med 'gro ba'i don du gyur par shog ces bya ste rigs pa rkyang ded byed pa'i bsgoms phrugs ma yin pa la (las)/ gzhan la bka' rgya dam tshig gi gnad yod pas/ tshigs (tshig) tsam mi bsgrags/ 'bru tsam yang mi bsten (bstan) par bya'o//
